profile.headline: IT Professional
profile.summary:
Versatile IT Professional with extensive experience in system administration, technical support, and web development. Proven track record of successfully managing enterprise-wide technology deployments, implementing security solutions, and providing high-level technical support across diverse environments. Demonstrated expertise in Windows/macOS ecosystems, network infrastructure management, and CMS platforms. Currently leveraging technical background in both professional and volunteer web development roles while seeking to expand impact in a dynamic IT position.

CORE COMPETENCIES
- IT Asset Management & Inventory Control
- Technology Procurement & Vendor Relations
- System Administration & Security
- Project Management & Implementation
- End-User Training & Documentation
- Technical Support & Troubleshooting
- Website Development and Content Management

TECHNICAL CERTIFICATIONS & SKILLS
- CompTIA A+ Certified
- Federal Security Clearance (Public Trust Level 5)
- Typing Speed: 116 WPM with 98% accuracy

TECHNOLOGY STACK
Operating Systems:
- Windows 10/11, macOS, iOS, Android
- Server environments: Active Directory, Exchange

Hardware:
- Enterprise Hardware: Dell, HP, Lenovo workstations
- Network Equipment: Cisco, Polycom, Allworx
- Mobile Devices: iOS and Android devices

Software & Tools:
- Enterprise: Microsoft Office Suite, Microsoft Dynamics NAV, Microsoft Access
- Security: Norton, McAfee, Checkpoint Endpoint Encryption
- Management: KACE, ServiceNow, Spiceworks
- Virtualization: VMware
- Remote Support: TeamViewer, Dameware

positions.title: Volunteer Web Developer
positions.description:
- Pro bono web developer and content manager for Carmel Clay Elementary PTO website (Finalsite CMS)
- Managed ongoing maintenance and development of key website sections
- Continued collaboration with PTO board to ensure effective communication with the school community
positions.insights: Skills: Website Building · Content Management · Web Content Writing

positions.title: IT Consultant
positions.description: Technical, hardware, and software troubleshooting, consultation, and problem solving both in person and remotely. Replacement of parts, and PC configuration/construction on commission.
positions.insights: Skills: Communication · Tracking Systems · Written Communication

positions.title: PC Technician
positions.description:
- Served as primary technical point of contact for 700+ users across 4 states, maintaining 99% satisfaction rate
- Implemented company-wide asset tracking system using KACE, improving inventory accuracy
- Managed all IT purchasing and inventory, reducing procurement cycles
- Executed remote and on-site troubleshooting for hardware/software issues without breaking SLA
positions.insights: Skills: Communication · Tracking Systems · Written Communication

positions.title: Remote Field User Support II
positions.description:
- Led successful Windows 10 deployment project across multiple CDC facilities with zero operational disruption
- Managed on-site tape backup library with 100% backup success rate
- Maintained average ticket resolution time of under 2 hours using HP Service Manager
- Supported critical CDC operations across Arctic Investigation Program, NIOSH division, and Quarantine station
positions.insights: Skills: Communication · Tracking Systems · Computer Repair · Asset Management · Written Communication · Video Conferencing · Government

positions.title: IT Manager
positions.description:
- Developed and implemented company’s first-ever IT standard operating procedures
- Negotiated new printer lease contract, resulting in 25% cost reduction
- Created comprehensive security protocols for remote access systems
- Established IT training program for new staff, reducing onboarding time
positions.insights: Skills: Communication · Tracking Systems · Written Communication

positions.title: Desktop Support Technician
positions.description:
- Led EventTracker deployment project, improving system monitoring capabilities
- Created internal security software deployment procedures and end-user guidelines
- Provided tier 2/3 technical support with 95% first-contact resolution rate
- Managed multi-branch desktop imaging and printer support operations
positions.insights: Skills: Communication · Tracking Systems · Written Communication · Computer Information Systems

positions.title: IT Specialist
positions.description:
- Successfully completed Windows 7 upgrade deployment for 200+ systems
- Maintained network infrastructure (LAN/WAN) with 99.9% uptime
- Reduced average ticket resolution time from 24 hours to 4 hours
- Implemented new ticketing system, drastically improving issue tracking efficiency
positions.insights: Skills: Communication · Tracking Systems · CompTIA A+ Certification · Written Communication

projects.title: Mobile Technology Consult
projects.description: Worked in partnership with the client advising how to acquire and what to use in regards to mobile information technology in order to meet their business objective efficiently.

projects.title: Event Tracker Deployment Lead
projects.description: Designated project lead on EventTracker software deployment project for First National Bank Alaska; coordinated installations and upgrades, bug-fixing, problem-solving, and testing/research for disabling USB-use company-wide. Acted as liaison between vendor and company.
